parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`: `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` in `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift` and `RouteChangeBehaviorTests.overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled` in `RouteChangeBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.714, the structural resemblance is characteristic of test methods that share a common setup/assertion pattern (e.g., play-state verification) while exercising distinct behavioral scenarios — idempotent play calls versus route-change override handling. Merging or extracting these test bodies would couple unrelated behavioral test suites and obscure the distinct intent of each test case. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where any record is `is_test: true` defaults to no-action.
